title: Dependency
description: A software dependency detected between services or to external targets.

source_service_id.description: The ID of the service that has this dependency.

target_service_id.description: The ID of the service being depended on, if known.

name.description: The name of the target (e.g. redis, https://api.stripe.com).

version.description: The version constraint of the dependency, if applicable.

confidence.description: Confidence score of the dependency detection.
